omopColumns.name: nhs_number
omopColumns.query:
select
    nhs_number,
    EVENT_END_DT_TM,
    EVENT,
    RESULT_VALUE,
    case
        when trim(EVENT) in ('Weight', 'Weight Measured')
            and (RESULT_UNITS is null or lower(trim(RESULT_UNITS)) in ('', '<no data>'))
        then 'kg'
        else RESULT_UNITS
    end as RESULT_UNITS,
    NORMAL_LOW,
    NORMAL_HIGH
from ##duckdb_source##
order by all
